requirements.alias-order-isolation: Tags own separate entries and one current uncancelled acquisition each. Network and parse work occur outside the mutex. Cancelled/replaced acquisitions cannot publish. Explicit tag requests resolve again after the preceding acquisition completes.
requirements.atomic-publication: All files validate before retain publishes under the metadata mutex. An error leaves the previous map entry unchanged.
requirements.cancellation-and-close: Waiters detach independently; the last departing waiter cancels unused acquisition. Close marks closed before cancellation and joins the poller and acquisition WaitGroup, with additions prohibited after close. User callbacks are not joined. Post-close admission returns ErrClosed (or an already-cancelled caller error).
requirements.last-good-and-explicit-error: The empty default reads its initialized resident entry. Failed updates preserve it; explicit acquisition errors propagate. Recovery is exercised with the same references.
requirements.maintainer-docs: docs/oci-snapshot-references.md explains selection, identity, cache ownership, validation, lifecycle, error contracts, and offline verification.
requirements.manifest-identity: ManifestDigest is desc.Digest from the verified ORAS copy; Digest and IfNoMatch retain annotation-insensitive semantics. Digest reuse compares only ManifestDigest. Parsing reads copied verified layers.
requirements.non-oci-compatibility: No config/auth or backend factory branches other than OCI change. Legacy packages including ECR, local, Git and object pass offline. Service-dependent cases remain excluded.
requirements.reference-validation: View accepts only an OCI tag or canonical complete sha256 digest and only replaces the reference field of the configured repository. The factory now passes the reference through.
requirements.resource-release: fetchFiles closes earlier streams on failure. SnapshotFromFiles defers all supplied closes up front. SnapshotFromPaths closes prior opens on open failure. Original errors are preserved. Poller stops its ticker.
requirements.retention-and-lifetime: retain keeps the default plus at most three extra entries; no independent parsed-content map exists. Callbacks hold immutable snapshot references and no store lock. Concurrent extra references settle within the bound while a callback survives eviction.
